params <- list(

```{r}
normalize_tcga_id <- function(x) {
  substr(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    ),
    1,
    16
  )
}


check_file <- function(
    file,
    description
) {
  if (
    !file.exists(
      file
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      description,
      " not found:\n",
      file
    )
  }
}


read_counts <- function(
    file,
    dataset
) {
  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset,
      " count matrix"
    )
  )

  counts <- as.matrix(
    read.csv(
      file,
      row.names = 1,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  suppressWarnings(
    storage.mode(
      counts
    ) <-
      "numeric"
  )

  if (
    anyNA(
      counts
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      ": count matrix contains NA/non-numeric values."
    )
  }

  if (
    any(
      counts < 0
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      ": count matrix contains negative values."
    )
  }

  
  if (
    anyDuplicated(
      rownames(
        counts
      )
    )
  ) {
    message(
      dataset,
      ": collapsing duplicated gene symbols by summing counts."
    )

    counts <- rowsum(
      counts,
      group =
        rownames(
          counts
        ),
      reorder =
        FALSE
    )
  }

  colnames(
    counts
  ) <-
    normalize_tcga_id(
      colnames(
        counts
      )
    )

  if (
    anyDuplicated(
      colnames(
        counts
      )
    )
  ) {
    warning(
      dataset,
      ": duplicated sample IDs after TCGA barcode shortening; ",
      "keeping the first occurrence."
    )

    counts <- counts[
      ,
      !duplicated(
        colnames(
          counts
        )
      ),
      drop =
        FALSE
    ]
  }

  counts
}


read_clinical <- function(
    file,
    dataset
) {
  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset,
      " clinical file"
    )
  )

  clinical <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE,
    fileEncoding =
      "UTF-8",
    na.strings = c(
      "NA",
      ""
    ),
    check.names =
      FALSE
  )

  required <- c(
    "sample_submitter_id",
    "MSI_TMB"
  )

  missing <- setdiff(
    required,
    names(
      clinical
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      missing
    ) >
      0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      " clinical file is missing: ",
      paste(
        missing,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  clinical <- clinical %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_submitter_id =
        normalize_tcga_id(
          sample_submitter_id
        ),

      MSI_TMB =
        factor(
          MSI_TMB,
          levels = c(
            "MSI-H",
            "MSS/TMB-H",
            "MSS/TMB-L"
          )
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        MSI_TMB
      )
    )

  clinical <- clinical[
    !duplicated(
      clinical$
        sample_submitter_id
    ),
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  rownames(
    clinical
  ) <-
    clinical$
      sample_submitter_id

  clinical
}


clean_pathway_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_remove(
      "^HALLMARK_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "_",
      " "
    )
}
```

```{r}
prepare_expression <- function(
    dataset,
    counts_file,
    clinical_file
) {
  counts <- read_counts(
    file =
      counts_file,
    dataset =
      dataset
  )

  clinical <- read_clinical(
    file =
      clinical_file,
    dataset =
      dataset
  )

  common_samples <- intersect(
    colnames(
      counts
    ),
    rownames(
      clinical
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      common_samples
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      ": no matching samples between counts and clinical data."
    )
  }

  counts <- counts[
    ,
    common_samples,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  clinical <- clinical[
    common_samples,
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(
        counts
      ),
      rownames(
        clinical
      )
    )
  )

  group <- droplevels(
    clinical$
      MSI_TMB
  )

  message(
    "\n",
    dataset,
    " group sizes:"
  )

  print(
    table(
      group
    )
  )

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts =
      counts,
    group =
      group
  )

  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(
    y,
    group =
      group,
    min.count =
      params$
        min_count
  )

  y <- y[
    keep,
    ,
    keep.lib.sizes =
      FALSE
  ]

  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(
    y,
    method =
      "TMM"
  )

  logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(
    y,
    log =
      TRUE,
    prior.count =
      params$
        logcpm_prior_count
  )

  message(
    dataset,
    ": ",
    nrow(
      logcpm
    ),
    " genes retained for pathway scoring."
  )

  list(
    dataset =
      dataset,

    clinical =
      clinical,

    expression =
      logcpm
  )
}
```

```{r}
run_ssgsea <- function(
    expression,
    gene_sets
) {
  gene_sets_present <- lapply(
    gene_sets,
    function(genes) {
      intersect(
        genes,
        rownames(
          expression
        )
      )
    }
  )

  gene_sets_present <- gene_sets_present[
    vapply(
      gene_sets_present,
      length,
      integer(1)
    ) >=
      params$
        min_genes_per_set
  ]

  message(
    "Gene sets retained after expression overlap: ",
    length(
      gene_sets_present
    )
  )

  
  
  
  scores <- tryCatch(
    {
      ssgsea_par <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(
        exprData =
          expression,

        geneSets =
          gene_sets_present,

        minSize =
          params$
            min_genes_per_set,

        maxSize =
          params$
            max_genes_per_set,

        normalize =
          TRUE
      )

      GSVA::gsva(
        ssgsea_par,
        verbose =
          FALSE
      )
    },

    error =
      function(e) {
        message(
          "Current GSVA API failed; trying legacy API.\n",
          conditionMessage(
            e
          )
        )

        NULL
      }
  )

  
  
  
  if (
    is.null(
      scores
    )
  ) {
    scores <- GSVA::gsva(
      expr =
        expression,

      gset.idx.list =
        gene_sets_present,

      method =
        "ssgsea",

      kcdf =
        "Gaussian",

      min.sz =
        params$
          min_genes_per_set,

      max.sz =
        params$
          max_genes_per_set,

      ssgsea.norm =
        TRUE,

      verbose =
        FALSE
    )
  }

  as.matrix(
    scores
  )
}
```

```{r}
fit_pathway_models <- function(
    scores,
    clinical,
    dataset
) {
  sample_order <- colnames(
    scores
  )

  clinical <- clinical[
    sample_order,
    ,
    drop =
      FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      sample_order,
      rownames(
        clinical
      )
    )
  )

  group <- factor(
    clinical$
      MSI_TMB,
    levels = c(
      "MSI-H",
      "MSS/TMB-H",
      "MSS/TMB-L"
    )
  )

  design <- stats::model.matrix(
    ~ 0 +
      group
  )

  colnames(
    design
  ) <- c(
    "MSI_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_L"
  )

  contrast_matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L =
      MSI_H -
      MSS_TMB_L,

    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H =
      MSI_H -
      MSS_TMB_H,

    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L =
      MSS_TMB_H -
      MSS_TMB_L,

    levels =
      design
  )

  fit <- limma::lmFit(
    scores,
    design
  )

  fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(
    fit,
    contrast_matrix
  )

  fit <- limma::eBayes(
    fit
  )

  extract_contrast <- function(
      contrast_name
  ) {
    limma::topTable(
      fit,
      coef =
        contrast_name,
      number =
        Inf,
      sort.by =
        "none",
      adjust.method =
        "BH"
    ) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column(
        "Pathway"
      ) %>%
      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Dataset =
          dataset,
        Contrast =
          contrast_name,
        .before =
          1
      )
  }

  results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    extract_contrast(
      "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
    ),

    extract_contrast(
      "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H"
    ),

    extract_contrast(
      "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
    )
  )

  list(
    fit =
      fit,

    results =
      results
  )
}
```

```{r}
make_plot_table <- function(
    model_results
) {
  comparison_lookup <- c(
    "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" =
      "MSS/TMB-L",

    "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H" =
      "MSS/TMB-H"
  )

  x <- model_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast %in%
        names(
          comparison_lookup
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Comparison =
        unname(
          comparison_lookup[
            Contrast
          ]
        ),

      significant =
        adj.P.Val <=
        params$
          fdr_cutoff
    )

  pathway_keep <- x %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Pathway
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      significant_any =
        any(
          significant,
          na.rm =
            TRUE
        ),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    )

  if (
    isTRUE(
      params$
        significant_only
    )
  ) {
    pathway_keep <- pathway_keep %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        significant_any
      )
  }

  x <- x %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      pathway_keep,
      by =
        "Pathway"
    )

  
  pathway_order <- x %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Comparison ==
        "MSS/TMB-L"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(
        logFC
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      Pathway
    )

  x %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pathway_label =
        clean_pathway_name(
          Pathway
        ),

      Pathway_label =
        factor(
          Pathway_label,
          levels =
            rev(
              clean_pathway_name(
                pathway_order
              )
            )
        ),

      Comparison =
        factor(
          Comparison,
          levels = c(
            "MSS/TMB-L",
            "MSS/TMB-H"
          )
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_pathway_expression <- function(
    plot_df,
    dataset,
    output_stub
) {
  if (
    nrow(
      plot_df
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      ": no pathways passed the plotting criteria."
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x =
        logFC,

      y =
        Pathway_label,

      fill =
        Comparison
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width =
            0.72
        ),

      width =
        0.64
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept =
        0,
      linewidth =
        0.45,
      color =
        "grey55"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values =
        params$
          comparison_colors,

      breaks = c(
        "MSS/TMB-L",
        "MSS/TMB-H"
      ),

      drop =
        FALSE,

      name =
        "Comparison"
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        "Pathway expression (GSVA) in MSI-H",

      subtitle =
        NULL,

      x =
        "logFC vs other subtype",

      y =
        "Pathway"
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_minimal(
      base_size =
        11
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face =
            "plain",
          hjust =
            0.5,
          size =
            12
        ),

      axis.title.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            14
        ),

      axis.title.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            18
        ),

      axis.text.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            8.5,
          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            9,
          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      panel.grid.major.y =
        ggplot2::element_line(
          color =
            "grey90",
          linewidth =
            0.35
        ),

      panel.grid.major.x =
        ggplot2::element_line(
          color =
            "grey90",
          linewidth =
            0.35
        ),

      panel.grid.minor =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      legend.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            9
        ),

      legend.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            9
        ),

      plot.margin =
        ggplot2::margin(
          8,
          8,
          8,
          8
        )
    )

  n_pathways <- dplyr::n_distinct(
    plot_df$
      Pathway
  )

  plot_height <- max(
    6,
    0.25 *
      n_pathways +
      2
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".svg"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      8.5,

    height =
      plot_height,

    device =
      "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".pdf"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      8.5,

    height =
      plot_height,

    device =
      grDevices::
        cairo_pdf
  )

  p
}
```

    "CRC",

      ucec_plot_df,

    Summary =
      significant_summary
  ),

  file =
    file.path(
      params$output_root,
      "CRC_UCEC_Hallmark_GSVA_results.xlsx"
    ),

  overwrite =
    TRUE
)
